text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a perf regression on canary for mixtral-8x7b after a RoPE scale tweak. ~20% drop in tokens/sec on long generations.

maria: repro steps?

alex: Repro: model=mixtral-8x7b q4_0, kernel_picker v2.1.0, rope_scale=0.95 in model config. Regression appears when gen_length > 128; profiler shows a switch to a generic matmul kernel.

ryan: can you paste the profiler hotspots and the tokenizer version?

alex: profiler snippet:
```
hotspots:
 - kernel: generic_matmul        62%  (active when seq_len > 128)
 - kernel: rope_scaled_attn     15%
 - kv_cache_touch              10%
 - other kernels               13%
```

alex: tokenizer change: we rolled a chat template that prepends explicit <BOS> + system prompt and enabled byte-fallback for some locales. avg prompt tokens +6%, and ~8-12% of requests hit byte-fallback tokens.

tj: byte-fallback can change token boundaries and shift sequence-length distribution. If token counts bump past a kernel-picker threshold we can end up in a slower code path. :thinking:

maria: also check head/kv dims. Mixtral there are 32 heads, kv_dim=128. If a mismatch or quantized kernel doesn't support that layout we fallback to generic matmul.

hema: quick local run: when rope_scale < 1.0 the rope_scaled_attn kernel expects pre-rotated KV layout. With extra BOS tokens the prefix cache warms differently and kernel_picker falls back.

ryan: can we force kernel_picker to prefer rope_scaled_attn for mixtral-8x7b when seq_len < 512 as a mitigation?

alex: forced override locally -> tokens/sec returned to baseline, memory +2%. So perf ok with small memory tradeoff.

maria: longer-term we should make kernel_picker consider tokenization stats (byte-fallback ratio, avg prompt length) when deciding; dynamic thresholds.

tj: also consider kv_warmup heuristics: if we detect a new chat template or high byte-fallback, pre-warm KV cache for first N tokens to avoid cache thrash during early generation.

alex: agreed. Immediate plan: 1) canary with kernel override + kv_warmup; 2) add telemetry for kernel_picker decision reason; 3) log per-request byte-fallback ratio.

tj: I'll create the canary config and baseline job. Canary includes: kernel_override=rope_scaled_attn, kv_warmup=64, tokenizer=previous-template.

ci-bot: canary created: id=c1234 route=runtimes/canary/mixtral-rope-fix created_by=tj

maria: follow-ups: file a bug to add unit test covering rope_scale handling with explicit BOS + byte-fallback tokenization, and a perf test for seq_len buckets (<=128, 129-512, >512).

ryan: also add a quick probe to kernel_picker to expose why generic_matmul was chosen (flag: unsupported_qk_layout / seq_len_threshold / quant_kernel_missing).

hema: one more note — Qwen variants behave differently because tokenization rarely triggers byte-fallback; so this is likely tokenizer+rope interaction specific to Mixtral locales. We'll keep an eye on cross-model effects.

alex: thanks. can we sync in the morning 10am to review canary results after a few hours? :eyes:

tj: meeting scheduled. thanks all :thumbsup:
